I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread. The latest date is 24 September, but it isn't settled yet, so I suggested she check with Ilse before it goes in the tracker.

- **How the date changed:** On 14 October Ilse posted 20 November in #north-team. Later that morning she corrected it in #north-random to 24 September, saying she'd read the wrong line. Dana is in #north-random, so she can see that correction herself.
- **Why it's not settled:** 24 September had already passed when Ilse posted it. I asked her then whether she meant next year or whether the form is already signed, and she hasn't answered. I also can't find a Tamsin order form in the shared files I can see, so I couldn't check either date.
- **The brain still has the old date:** I tried to remove the 20 November entry, but the brain said it couldn't find it. Its notes on Tamsin Cold Chain may still show both dates.
